lemmas.lemma: ha noe å stille opp med
lemmas.primary_translation: to have something to use as a counterweight, obstacle, or counterargument / to have something to help oneself with / to have something to offer or bring to bear

word_forms.word_form: ha noe å stille opp med

definitions.text: ha noe å bruke som motvekt, hinder eller motargument
definitions.translation: have something to use as a counterweight, obstacle, or counterargument

definitions.text: ha noe å hjelpe seg med
definitions.translation: have something to help oneself with

definitions.text: ha noe å by på eller fare med
definitions.translation: have something to offer or bring to bear

examples.no: jeg har ikke noe å stille opp med mot henne
examples.en: I have nothing to put up against her

examples.no: de har lite å stille opp med mot motstanderen
examples.en: They have little to put up against their opponent
